brief: A complex, rotating kinetic sculpture dominates the view, centered around a viscous, glowing pool of molten bronze. Around this core, multiple ornate splines orbit, tracing continuous, ethereal paths. These orbital structures appear to be crafted from oxidized copper meshed with fragments of deep sea glass. The entire assembly performs a slow, ceaseless, and mesmerizing motion, combining the rigid geometries of steampunk art with the flowing glow of the molten material.
